text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worried about Furioso not showing up for 
training, I went looking for her and ended 
up...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
~♪ Fufu, what a truly beautiful beach. 
There are so many seashells I never see 
back home.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
! Are you looking for shells too, Trainer? 
It brings back memories, clam digging in 
Funabashi—
choice_data_list: Furioso, you're past time for training

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!? I-I'm so sorry! I was just 
overwhelmed with nostalgia...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave a firm warning so that the same 
mistake wouldn't happen again.
